summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish on long-term equity indices, evidenced by massive call buying in SPX and SPXW with extremely low Put/Call ratios (0.43 and 0.20, respectively). Significant directional conviction is seen in the massive accumulation of SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes expiring in 2026, alongside heavy single-day premium in MSTR ($335.9M BuyCall) and MU ($243.2M BuyCall). Persistent institutional interest is confirmed by the $3.14B accumulation in SPX 6000C (exp 2026-05-15) and $1.34B in SPX 6000C (exp 2026-09-18) over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor sector (MU, AMD, SOXL) and monitor if the massive SPX 8000P (exp 2026-09-18) $418.8M position acts as a tail-risk hedge or a signal of extreme volatility expectations.
